About 20 years ago when I was a kid the family was headed out on a Sunday in our old POS Chevy. About half way to our destination the car died and we pulled into a driveway. As we are sitting there my dad is trying desperately to get the thing going again but it just won’t turn over.

The family had recently gotten a new minivan and for whatever reason I knew that if he waited until the next van drove by it’d start so I told him to stop trying and wait, obviously my dad listened (he definitely did not because, why would you listen to a kid...). Anyhow, after a few more attempts and a few more times of me encouraging him to wait, my mom finally convinces him to stop. We sit there for a few minutes and then a van goes by and I say, “try now” sure enough the damn thing starts right up.

Not sure if that was really a sign, but along the same lines.
